Metamagic Rods | Other Rods
Rod of Metamagic, Merciful
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 190, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 295
Aura strong (no school) CL 17th
Slot none; Price 1,500 gp (lesser), 5,500 gp (normal), 12,250 gp (greater); Weight 5 lbs.
Description
The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that deal nonlethal damage as though using the Merciful Spell feat (Advanced Player’s Guide).
Construction
Requirements Craft Rod, Merciful Spell; Cost 750 gp (lesser), 2,750 gp (normal), 6,125 gp (greater)
